source_v3.author_policy: 20 roots per author; 16 development authors use 15/2/3 or 15/3/2; two dedicated heldout and two dedicated OOD authors do not read development data
source_v3.root_group_policy: one root per group and one group per root; all descendants stay in the frozen split
source_v3.unadjudicated_policy: quarantine without changing semantic labels; author proxy labels are not independent teacher acceptance
source_v3.input_audit: reuse features.request_view/request_text; reject cross-split fingerprints, same-input label conflicts and exact duplicate inputs across roots; near-neighbor candidates require independent review
source_v3.outputs: train/dev/calibration only in trainable directory; heldout/OOD/quarantine/full audit in physically disjoint sealed directory; refuse existing output directories
source_v3.legacy_relabel: explicit --legacy-relabel repairs temporary/uncertain distractor pair labels, records original/repaired labels, keeps original whole rows unchanged

main_comparison.same_budget_scope: same optimizer updates and presented sample instances, not same tokens or independent roots
main_comparison.epoch_early_stopping: 8 epochs with early stopping is a separate later experiment, not this fixed-update comparison

calibration_v3.api: metrics.calibrate_partitioned(logits, labels, has_trigger, group_ids, roles, primary, *, stage='complete'); training CLI always stage='candidate'; legacy six-vector mathematical API stays compatible
calibration_v3.independent_unit: semantic root; group_id fallback only for legacy rows without root metadata, never descendant rows or group aliases
calibration_v3.primary_policy: exactly one preselected primary per root in every role; never reselect after labels or predictions
calibration_v3.prob: fit temperature on prob roots only, root-equal; insufficient prob data is explicitly unfitted temperature=1 and threshold=null
calibration_v3.policy: select the first feasible grid threshold from one frozen primary per policy root only
calibration_v3.candidate_artifact: top-level threshold=null and threshold_feasible=false; selection.candidate_threshold is policy-only; audit.status=deferred with counts and bounds null
calibration_v3.physical_inputs: arm development files contain train/dev/calibration-prob/calibration-policy only; shared dev/prob/policy content hashes, members and labels across arms; audit is a separate calibration-audit pair file and disjoint from every development root
calibration_v3.input_contract: planned_manifest, metrics and scorer record training_input_contract.sha256_by_partition/root_ids_by_partition/row_counts with unit=semantic_root_not_descendant_rows and audit_visible=false
calibration_v3.study_lock: train --mode lock binds one pre-registered dev-only selected candidate, meta/weights SHA, classes, temperature, policy point and development lineage in one fixed new runs directory; coordinator must not rename study or create another lock to retry selection
calibration_v3.audit_api: metrics.audit_locked_partition(logits, labels, has_trigger, group_ids, roles, primary, *, temperature, candidate_threshold, point_feasible)
calibration_v3.audit: train --mode audit verifies commitment/artifact binding and exclusively writes audit-attempt before reading independent audit primaries; never refits temperature or reselects grid; risk and coverage one-sided CP bounds each alpha=.025; insufficient evidence yields top-level threshold=null in a new scorer, original artifact unchanged
calibration_v3.audit_once: one attempt per fixed study lock including failures; null candidate never opens/hashes/probes audit; no nine-run/size/recipe audits treated as a single certification
calibration_v3.lock_boundary: process commitment and file integrity, not remote-identity authentication or protection against malicious alternate studies; no human gold

feature_boundary: request text surface only: candidate/existing text+trigger and evidence source text; no ids, labels, provenance, group_id, split, teacher votes, tier/permanence metadata, or expected outputs
external_credentials: environment only; never argv/files/logs; do not copy a chat credential

safety_metrics.no_feasible_threshold_policy: report no feasible point; do not force an operating threshold or claim readiness
safety_metrics.promotion: never in this experiment; independent human labels and production review absent

interfaces.schema: canonical_request(request)->canonical dict (raw synthetic or desensitized shapes; identity dropped, permission bits ignored, tier/permanence optional metadata); load_rows(path)->list[dict]; validate_row(row)->None; materialize_request(request)->(candidate, existing, evidence, cfg); feature_view/features_from_request read only text/trigger/evidence text
interfaces.training: pair rows only (existing <=1; set/multi-rule rows excluded and counted); RelationScorer.classes equals spec classes; RelationScorer.predict_proba(requests)->numpy[n,7]; features.load_scorer(model_dir, device='cpu') is the only public loader, including finetune dispatch; train CLI --data --out --models --sizes --seeds --eval-splits none --calibration-protocol partitioned --calibration-stage candidate; finetune additionally --checkpoint-selection best-dev --selection-metric dev-loss --patience 0 --max-steps 400 --eval-every-steps 50 --max-length 384; dev-loss is root-equal with row-loss secondary, selected CPU state is restored before candidate calibration/export; train --mode lock --model-dir --lock-dir --study-id and --mode audit --lock-dir --data --out provide one independent audit attempt for one pre-registered dev-selected candidate; no group/root-leakage escape flag or audit/terminal hash/probe in candidate/none mode
interfaces.adapter: make_predictor(scorer, threshold=None) rejects None rather than silently using zero; callable(request)->five-field dict; metrics.pair_verdict is the only gate; no API fallback or top-k truncation; evaluate_sets reports all-attempt completion and correct-completed/N, raw classifier/pair/set/gated set separately and related/evidence references by role; primary_operating uses one preselected primary per root; default CLI requires numeric meta.threshold and strictly true threshold_feasible; explicit threshold requires --diagnostic; --oracle-aggregation reuses real adapter/production gate with proxy reference pair labels
interfaces.teachers: same attempt/record/repair ledger; legacy label/paraphrase uses full production projection, not a fair student-text comparison; export-blind --input --output --blind-dir --blind-map --teacher-id --teacher-provider --teacher-model --shard-size --seed --synthetic-only exports features.request_view with random ids and private map outside blind directory; import-agent-label --input --output --blind-input --blind-map --agent-run-id verifies real receipts, assigned independent teacher/run/input/protocol hashes and strict five fields/role references; missing/failed/disagreeing labels remain pending/null, not synthetic uncertain; export/import calls no API and usage/latency remain null; legacy credentials from environment only
interfaces.challenge: unchanged data/challenge.jsonl and data/set_challenge.jsonl, agent_review proxy labels; already exposed diagnostic regression data, never a new independent terminal test or checkpoint-selection source; manifest retains data and legacy spec hashes and binds the current compatible spec; batch merge differences remain phenomena.merge_policy
